unavailable_or_unclassified: All training outputs/references and payload remain coherent through ONE batch. The learned small decoder belongs to that batch and is not reusable on later original-D outputs. The factor2 all-accepted inverse floor, max(0,1-delta)^2 fidelity range, exact rational feasibility/fallback and total reference-safe implementation error are mandatory. Query count is polynomial in intrinsic dimensions/inverse accuracy, with enormous explicit constants; ambient storage and controls are paid. Fixed-d predecessor compiler and separately reviewed uniform compiler have distinct costs. No source-memory/drift, hardware, optimal-query or novelty claim.
